# Reproducible consumer fixtures

Unmodified DejaVu Sans and Sans Bold, from Debian fonts-dejavu-core installed with
this checkpoint's preparation environment. Upstream: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/.
Copyright and redistribution terms: LICENSE-DejaVu.txt. These are test resources,
not system-font discovery and not a promise of general font coverage.
